title: Lantern and Compass
author: Freya Thackeray
blurb: Mirabel Marchetti, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
